open_spaces_details.description: two two-storey sport pavilions, 3G pitch with dual use, junior 3G pitch with a running track, creation of an access road and parking, installation of floodlighting and associated landscape works. Refurbishment of the boat house, gym and boat shed to include demolition of part and erection of a two-storey extension to the boat house.
open_spaces_details.open_space_type: Outdoor sports facilities incl. school playing fields

description: Variation of condition 3 (approved drawings) to allow the ground floor of the existing boat house to be extended to provide additional boat storage facility and make minor internal and elevational alterations following planning permission 00567/D/P13 dated 05/03/2020 for erection of two two storey sport pavilions, 3G pitch with dual use, junior 3G pitch with running track, creation of an access road and parking, installation of floodlighting and associated landscape works. Refurbishment of the boat house, gym and boat shed to include demolition of part and erection of a two storey extension to the boat house
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Original drawings AST-EBH-ZZ-DR-A-20-102, AST-EBH-ZZ-DR-A-05-002, AST-SM-ZZ-DR-A-20-005, AST-SM-ZZ-DR-A-20-003, AST-BH-ZZ-DR-A-20-101, AST-RP-ZZ-DR-A-20-101, AST-EBH-ZZ-DR-A-20-101, AST-SM-ZZ-DR-A-20-004, AST-SM-ZZ-DR-A-20-101, AST-SM-ZZ-DR-A-20-102, AST-EBH-ZZ-DR-A-20-103, Ground floor site plan, AST-BH-ZZ-DR-A-05-001, AST-BH-ZZ-DR-A-05-002, AST-RP-ZZ-DR-A-05-001, AST-RP-ZZ-DR-A-05-002, AST-EBH-ZZ-DR-A-05-001, AST-SM-ZZ-DR-A-20-101, AST-SM-ZZ-DR-A-20-102, AST-EBH-ZZ-DR-A-20-103, AST-BH-ZZ-DR-A-20-201, AST-RP-ZZ-DR-A-20-201, AST-EBH-ZZ-DR-A-20-201, AST-SM-ZZ-DR-A-20-001 received 26/10/2019
New drawings  Design and access statement Addendum, AST- EBH-ZZ -DR -A -20 -101, AST- EBH-ZZ -DR -A -20 - 103, AST- EBH-ZZ -DR -A -20 -102, AST- EBH-ZZ -DR -A -20 -201, AST- EBH - DR- A- 05 -001-A, AST -  SM -ZZ -DR -A -20 - 002, AST - SM -ZZ -DR -A -20 - 003 Received: 01/03/2023) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - Prior to above ground works, samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the buildings hereby permitted shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for the sports facilities and associated bar and club rooms shall not be carried on outside the following times: Monday - Sunday 07:00 - 23:00.
Condition : 4 - The floodlighting hereby permitted shall not be used outside the following times: Monday - Sunday 07:00 - 22:00.

Condition : 5 - The floodlighting details shall be those approved under application 00567/D/P13(7-25) on 07/05/2021 unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 6 - Works shall be carried out in line with the Ground Investigation Report approved under application 00567/D/P13(8-23) on 25/09/2020 unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority
If required, a scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority, for written approval. The scheme shall account for any comments made by the Local Planning Authority before the development hereby permitted is first occupied. During the course of the development: c. The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues. Before the development for each phase of the development is first brought into use: d. The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clauses b) and c) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Condition : 7 - The hard and soft landscape strategy and management plan shall be that approved under application 00567/D/P13(7-25) on 07/05/2021 which includes landscaping detailing, long term design objectives, management responsibilities and maintenance schedules for all hard and soft landscape areas.  
Any trees or shrubs planted which die within five years of completion of the development shall be replaced with the same species, and of comparable maturity, or an approved alternative. The landscape strategy and management plan shall be carried out as approved and maintained as such thereafter.
Condition : 8 - The drainage strategy shall be in line with that approved under application 00567/D/P13(10i) on 26/10/2020.

Condition : 9 - The finalised Energy Strategy (demonstrating how the 35% target for carbon dioxide emissions reduction are to be met in line with the Mayor's energy hierarchy and cooling hierarchy) shall be that approved under application 00567/D/P13(8-23) on 25/09/2020. 
The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy and works above ground level for the approved new pavilion buildings shall not commence until full Design Stage calculations under the National Calculation Method have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local planning Authority to show that the development will be constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.
c) No later than three months after first occupation of the building(s) evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the National Calculation Method) should be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.

Condition : 10 - The BREEAM New Construction Shell and Core preliminary-assessment estimator shall be those approved under application 00567/D/P13(8-23) on 25/09/2020. 
Within 12 weeks from first occupation of the buildings, a BREEAM New Construction Shell and Core Post-Construction Review certificate and summary score sheet (or such equivalent standard that replaces this) must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to show that an 'Excellent' rating has been achieved.

Condition : 11 - In this condition ""retained tree"" means an existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars; and paragraphs (a) and (b) below shall have effect until the expiration of (5 years) from (the date of the occupation of the building for its permitted use). (a) No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the written approval of the local planning authority. Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard [3998 (Tree Work)] or any other BS replacing. (b) If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the local planning authority. (c) The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved plans and particulars before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site. Nothing shall be stored or placed in any area fenced in accordance with this condition and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation be made, without the written consent of the local planning authority.

Condition : 12 - The details of the boundary treatments shall be in line with those approved under application 00567/D/P13(7-25) on 07/05/2021. The boundary treatment shall be completed before (the use hereby permitted is commenced) or (before the building(s) is/are occupied) or (in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the local planning authority). Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 13 - The details of the buffer zone shall be in line with the details approved under application 00567/D/P13(7-25) on 07/05/2021. Thereafter, the development shall be carried out with the approved scheme. Any subsequent variations shall be agreed in writing by the local planning authority, in which case the development shall be carried out in accordance with the amended scheme. The buffer zone scheme shall be free from built development including lighting, domestic gardens and formal landscaping.

Condition : 14 - The Artificial Grass Pitch hereby permitted shall not be constructed other than in accordance with Sport England Technical Design Guidance Notes Artificial Surfaces for Outdoor Sport.

Condition : 15 - The gates across the vehicular access from Hartington Road shall be set back 15m from the public highway and be in compliance with the approved application 00567/D/P13(17-21) on 15/07/2021. The gates shall thereafter be operated in compliance with the approved details.

Condition : 16 - The details of the proposed access shall be those approved under application 00567/D/P13(17-21) on 15/07/2021. No part of the development shall be occupied until the new means of access and waiting restrictions have been sited, laid out and constructed in accordance with the approved details, and the existing access onto Hartington Road removed and the footway, verge and kerb reinstated.

Condition : 17 - The parking, loading/unloading and turning spaces as shown on the approved plans shall be constructed (base course) and made available for use by the contractor and thereafter shall not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 18 - Before the development hereby permitted is first brought into use, the parking, loading/unloading and turning spaces as shown on the approved plans shall be fully constructed and made available for use and thereafter shall not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 19 - The details of electric vehicle charging infrastructure shall be those approved under application 00567/D/P13(17-21) on 15/07/2021. The approved infrastructure shall be fully implemented and be made available for use before the first occupation of the development and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Condition : 20 - The cycle parking facilities for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development shall be those approved under application 00567/D/P13(7-25) on 07/05/2021. The approved facilities shall conform to current guidance such as the TfL London Cycling Design Standards in design and layout and be fully implemented and be made available for use before the first occupation of the development and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Condition : 21 - The Construction Logistics Plan shall be that approved under application 00567/D/P13(8-23) on 25/09/2020. The approved Plan shall be adhered to throughout the construction period. The Plan shall accord with the latest TfL guidance.

Condition : 22 - The details of the public access path along the Thames and through the site to Ibis Lane shall be those approved under application 00567/D/P13(7-25) on 07/05/2021. The path shall be constructed as per the approved details prior to the occupation of the development.

Condition : 23 - The arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials shall be those approved under application 00567/D/P13(7-25) on 07/05/2021. The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with this approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 24 - Notwithstanding the plans hereby approved a revised energy strategy exploring the feasibility of an increase in the use of renewable technologies in particular, the potential for greater use of photovoltaics to maximise the site's potential as outlined in the London Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing prior to occupation of the development hereby approved and shall be fully implemented and maintained thereafter in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 25 - Details of flood resilient features proposed at application stage including waterproof materials, raising of plug sockets above the predicted flood level and installing hard flooring shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority at as built stage of the development hereby approved and shall be fully implemented and maintained thereafter in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 26 - Vehicular access to the consented development from Ibis Lane shall only be for the purposes of emergency access and egress and waste and refuse collection for the lifetime of the development.
